snippet.title: Alice In Vivaldi's Four Seasons: The Music Game Full Playthrough
snippet.description:
Music Games International presents the next music game installation, Alice In Vivaldi's Four Seasons. Alice is trapped inside a magical clock with music, and it's up to us on freeing her. We have to play through all 12 levels of the game in order to fix the clock and set Alice free. A nice white cat with pink stripes will guide you on how to complete levels. Coming soon, the final installation music game of an old holiday legend that involves a nutcracker with music. Tchaikovsky's Nutcracker: The Music Game. Coming this Fall/Winter.




Notice: I do not own the characters, I do not own the music in the game nor I did not make this game. This was made by Music Games International and songs is owned and made by their original creators, author and composers.
